findings.title: How-to claims code HEAD `1ce149a76` and verification at that commit; frozen audit head is `52855fb35ea40f420bdacdcab9e092f8d15292c6`.
findings.body: Lines: 'code committed at HEAD `1ce149a76`' and Verification 'At commit `1ce149a76`…105 tests'. Subject identifies frozen content head 52855fb… (3 commits from base). Stale or wrong HEAD citation for the delivered tree. [docs/02-how-to/memory-bridge.md] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED as a documentation defect; severity LOW, not MEDIUM. `docs/02-how-to/memory-bridge.md` lines 19 and 137 cite commit `1ce149a76`. `git diff 1ce149a76 52855fb35 -- plugins` is empty: the only change after it is the how-to itself, so the cited facts (code at that commit, 105 tests, validate pass) are true of the frozen tree. The defect is the pinned SHA: it reads as the delivered head and goes stale at the next commit, the same pattern the Pulse audit raised as F4 and repaired. Repair is a docs-only edit (drop the SHA) but it changes the audited subject, so it needs the operator's decision.

findings.title: Slash command description says 'Store a note in the capture ledger' while the command reply and intent require queued-not-stored messaging.
findings.body: session.start registers description: 'Store a note in the capture ledger'; command.run returns text with 'Queued' and 'Nothing is stored yet'. Menu copy overclaims persistence relative to replay semantics. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED; severity LOW; the wording is a packet defect. `register.tsx:1208` registers the description `Store a note in the capture ledger`; `register.tsx:1240` replies `Queued your note ... Nothing is stored yet`. The description came from the issuance packet (W03 invariant L03) and the implementer followed it. Menu text overclaims relative to the queued-then-replayed behaviour. Repair is one string.

findings.title: Status pending includes other sessions' replayable rows that this mod will never send, so 📮 N pending can stick until those files change outside this process.
findings.body: readPrior adds isReplayable counts into foldedPending; replay only walks s.rings (this process). README documents counting newest eight other files; intent (e) says other-session replay not built. Misleading 'waiting' semantics. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED and disclosed; severity LOW stands; candidate for an accepted-risk ruling. `readPrior` adds other sessions' replayable pending rows to `foldedPending`, while replay walks only this process's rings, so `📮 N pending` can stay non-zero for rows another (ended) session left. README lines 106, 151 and 184 and the how-to's Not built table say other sessions' rows are counted but not replayed. Behaviour is documented and intended as a limit, but the label `pending` is misleading for those rows. A proper fix is the undesigned adoption rule.

findings.title: decisionsOf runs RegExp matchAll on the full unbounded assistant answer before any size bound.
findings.body: decisionsOf(answer) has no pre-trim; clean() bounds only matched capture groups. A multi-megabyte answer could cost CPU on every turn.complete (privacy still OK — answer not stored). [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED; severity INFO; the ReDoS framing is not substantiated. `decisionsOf` calls `matchAll` on the whole `answer` with no pre-trim (`register.tsx:209-216`), unlike `clean()`. The regex is anchored per line with no nested quantifiers, so the cost is linear in the answer length per finished turn, not catastrophic. No stored content is affected.

findings.title: Successful ledger emit increments attempts; docs describe attempts as failed-delivery counters.
findings.body: markRow on outcome==='ok' sets attempts: row.attempts + 1; test expects attempts===1 after success. README emphasizes attempts on non-zero/timeout only. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED as a documentation inaccuracy; severity LOW. On exit 0 the code writes `attempts: row.attempts + 1` (a sent row has attempts 1; tested). `README.md:43` describes `attempts` as `a counter of failed delivery attempts`. Behaviour is harmless and tested; the README line is inaccurate.

findings.title: On /clear, fold path that increments foldedPending from isReplayable is unreachable.
findings.body: Ring is deleted only when !entries.some(isReplayable); the following loop still branches on isReplayable. Dead code; behaviour still correct because replayable rings are retained. [plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx] ADJUDICATION: Coordinator: CONFIRMED; severity INFO. In the `/clear` branch (`register.tsx` about 1350-1366) the ring is deleted only when no entry is replayable, so the `if (isReplayable(entry.row)) s.foldedPending += 1` branch can never run. Dead code; behaviour is correct.
